criteria.name: Contrast (minimum)
criteria.evidence: axe color-contrast on 8 of 27 stories (Primary, PrimaryWithIcon, PrimaryOutlined, ButtonLink, Default, Focus, LongContent, Keyboard): #FFFFFF on #EF0071 is 4.27:1 at 16px normal, 4.5:1 needed; the same in today and redesign
criteria.note: The fill is the city primary colour of the story city, used as is. Heal (a11y): pick the text colour against the tenant colour, or darken the fill until the pair reaches 4.5:1.

criteria.name: Reflow
criteria.evidence: screenshots and scroll width at 1280, 390 and 320: no horizontal scroll; LongContent wraps inside the button

criteria.name: Non-text contrast
criteria.evidence: screenshots: outlined variants keep a border in the text colour; the focus outline is 2px #000 on white (21:1)

criteria.name: Text spacing
criteria.evidence: text spacing override (line height 1.5, letter 0.12em, word 0.16em, paragraph 2em) on Default and LongContent: no clipped text

criteria.name: Keyboard
criteria.evidence: Keyboard story (play): Tab focuses the button, Enter and Space each call onClick; Playwright Tab run on Default, Primary and RTL at 1280, 390 and 320

criteria.name: Focus visible
criteria.evidence: keyboard run: outline goes from none to solid 2px rgb(0, 0, 0) on Tab, in all variants checked

criteria.name: Focus not obscured (minimum)
criteria.evidence: screenshots: nothing in the component covers the focused button

criteria.name: Consistent help
criteria.evidence: page level: the component offers no help mechanism

criteria.name: Redundant entry
criteria.evidence: flow level: the component asks for no data

criteria.name: Accessible authentication (minimum)
criteria.evidence: flow level: the component is not part of a login step

criteria.name: Name, role, value
criteria.evidence: axe button-name passes on all 27 stories; processing sets aria-disabled; aria-expanded, aria-pressed and aria-controls pass through
criteria.note: Icon-only buttons get their name from the caller (BackOfficeIconOnly does).
